en_US: A tool made in Godot to visually create dialogs in an Unreal Engine project.
fr_FR: Un outil fait sur Godot pour créer visuellement des dialogues pour un projet Unreal Engine.

en_US:
[b]Editor tools[/b] to edit the dialogs of an RPG school project, [url="https://potassium-shot.eu/project/kokopeli\"]Kokopelli[/url]. Used by the Game Designers.

This tool allows for the creation of [b]complex dialog[/b] for an RPG project at Isart. It was made under Godot, and exports to Unreal. It is able to create complex looping dialog, with multiple characters, [b]triggering events[/b] from within, applying [b]special effects to the text[/b] easily, all within an interface that contains all the tools usually expected of a tool, like [b]undo/redo, searching text, recent files[/b], etc.

It was made in a little more than a week, during pre-production time and personal time, as [b]tool development is a passion of mine[/b].

[font_size=30]Why Godot?[/font_size]

Godot being very [b]fit for making tools[/b], it is the reason developing this tool was so quick, it allowed me to focus on the features of the tool [b]much more efficiently[/b] than if it were to be integrated within Unreal itself. Besides, the back and forth between Unreal and the tool was only minimal, as exporting to unreal only took the click of a button. So in the end, the time gain was very worth it.
A game of golf that is more about reflection than precision.
fr_FR: Un jeu de golf basé plus sur la réflection que sur la précision.

en_US:
[font_size=30]Synopsis[/font_size]

Hyper Balls is a [b]puzzle[/b], [b]golf-like[/b] game where you throw Balls at targets. Each target must receive one Ball. There are different zones with [b]different effects[/b], some of which slow the Balls down, speeds them up, or even make the Balls explode! Then, some zones are used to [b]activate/deactivate[/b] other zones - and that's where this simple golf game turns into a puzzle game.This is the first game I published (although not the first I made), and it was made in a bit more than a week, so there aren't many levels. (3 tutorial levels + 7 normal levels)
A vertical slice for an RPG made in Unreal Engine at Isart, with 20 people (2D/3D artists, game designers, gameplay programmers, engine programmers and sound designers)

A vertical slice (demo) for an RPG made in Unreal Engine at Isart, with 20 people (2D/3D artists, game designers, gameplay programmers, engine programmers and sound designers) See also the [url="https://potassium-shot.eu/project/dialog-tool"]dialog creation tool[/url] I made for it. [font_size=30]The Game[/font_size] Kokopelli is a tun-based RPG taking place in Albuquerque, USA. You embody the member of a Spirit Brigade in charge of befriending spirits in a world in which humans and spirits live in harmony. The combat gameplay opposes the player to a spirit. They both have [b]dolls[/b], and make use of [b]dice[/b], that each opponent throws to [b]attack[/b], [b]heal[/b], or do others actions. There are [b]5 turns[/b], and the one who [b]killed the most dolls at the end wins[/b]. The catch is that, the fights are very hard, and barely winnable. So to win, you actually have to [b]cheat[/b].

My role

I am the one who made the dialog system, as can be seen in the dialog creation tool page. I also made the camera, with various tools to manipulate it in different sections of the level design. And I worked on the inventory. This is without counting various smaller features and many, many bug fixes.
Game jam game about a ghost that shoots salt.

[b]Salty Ghosts[/b] Is a game made in 3 days by me, another gameplay programmer and an artist. It involves shooting ghost enemies with salt, but as you are a ghost too, the [b]]salt you shoot can hurt you[/b].
There are multiple [b]enemies[/b], like the basic one that pursues you, but also one that create [b]repulsions[/b], and one that creates moving [b]tornadoes[/b]. The repulsions and tornados themselves don't hurt you ; but they [b]bring salt with them[/b], which can potentially hit you.
On the final level, there is a [b]boss[/b] with multiple patterns, which are harder versions of the patterns of the enemies.
A hack and slash prototype in Godot.
fr_FR: Un prototype de hack and slash dans Godot.

en_US: A small project aimed at making a [b]juicy[/b], good-feeling hack and slash prototype. It features blade combat with a [b]combo[/b] system, and small [b]enemies[/b] that can be destroyed. The game puts emphasis on [b]air combat[/b]: there are special moves for jumping and slashing, and enemies can be [b]launched and juggled[/b] in the air. They also take fall damage.
